name: Oracle Seal Console
description: Encrypt a non-empty JSON object locally with the current Neo N3 Morpheus Oracle key, persist the exact ciphertext for recovery, and record a receipt only after confidential storage returns a valid reference.
description_zh: 使用当前 Neo N3 Morpheus 预言机密钥在本地加密非空 JSON 对象，持久化完全相同的密文用于恢复，并且只在机密存储返回有效引用后记录回执。

operation_panel.title: Confidential Seal Studio
operation_panel.subtitle: Use the native workbench to validate, encrypt, store, and recover exact ciphertext packets.

tee.description: This MiniApp encrypts locally and stores ciphertext. It does not execute confidential compute or independently verify a TEE attestation.

zk.description: No zero-knowledge proof is generated or verified by this MiniApp.
